content:
We have carbon NMR data: peaks at 170.20, 169.60, 151.28, 134.64, 132.51, 124.01, 123.09, 122.26, 20.67 ppm.

Methyl carbon typically around 10-30 ppm. There's a peak at 20.67 ppm, likely a methyl carbon. Only one methyl group? Could be more but overlapping? Only one low-field carbon. So count methyl groups = 1.

We could verify with proton NMR to see methyl protons. Let's get proton NMR.
